query: Which material can be used for lightweight and superior comprehensive performance, and why?

generation.hypothesis: Aluminum alloy (Al-Mg-Ti) with optimized composition can achieve lightweight and superior comprehensive performance.
generation.intervention: Addition of lightweight elements such as Al, Mg, or Ti with specific composition ratios (e.g., Al-5%Mg-2%Ti) and processing conditions (e.g., 500°C, 2 hours of annealing)
generation.conditions: General operating conditions, including temperature range (-20°C to 100°C) and loading conditions (up to 100 MPa)
generation.mechanism: The addition of Mg and Ti elements to Al alloy leads to the formation of precipitates (e.g., Al3Ti, Mg2Si) that refine the grain structure and enhance the strength of the alloy, while maintaining a low density (~2.7 g/cm³)
generation.predicted_outcome: 20% increase in specific strength (strength-to-weight ratio) and 15% improvement in corrosion resistance compared to traditional Al alloys
generation.boundary: Alloy composition ratios and processing conditions
generation.uncertainty: The actual performance of the optimized Al-Mg-Ti alloy may vary depending on the specific composition ratios, processing conditions, and testing methods used

falsification_experiment.design: Tensile testing and corrosion testing of optimized Al-Mg-Ti alloy samples
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the optimized Al-Mg-Ti alloy exhibits less than 15% increase in specific strength or less than 10% improvement in corrosion resistance compared to traditional Al alloys, the hypothesis is falsified
